draft_caption: Global Test 2B trajectories for all seven Representation B models. Integrated cloud and rain water use m^3 under unit reference density. Kinetic energy is not total energy, and projected relative-vorticity squared is not potential enstrophy.

editorial_revision.scope: caption terminology only; rendered asset and CSV unchanged

metric_definitions.M_c/M_r: Domain integrals of conservative cloud/rain water variables.
metric_definitions.mixed-state endpoints: Stored final and maximum relative mixed mass-norm errors; no time series was present.
metric_definitions.projected relative-vorticity squared: 0.5*integral(zeta_h^2) dA after CG(3) L2 projection; not potential enstrophy.
metric_definitions.total-water drift: Relative change of integral(Qv+Qc+Qr) from its initial value.

notes: Truth and model time grids were verified identical at steps 0--160.
A mixed-state-error trajectory would require a deployment rerun and is deferred.
scientific_question: Do frozen deployed models reproduce long-time global physical evolution?
support_classification: Test 2B deployed trajectories, states 0--160; truth events at 5100 and 12000 s
